name: Sorata Keisuke
source:
A former mercenary and the agency's most militant detective.

She has the face of a sparkling idol,
and incredible physical ability.

She's friendly to everyone,
but she's not attached to anything and lives a carefree life.

Her various experiences
make her live by the motto, "When a person dies, that's it."...
[From [url=https://and-zero.com/characters/keisuke]Official site[/url]]
